longDescription: Apple Shortcuts turns any button into a launcher for your Mac's Shortcuts app. The Property Inspector reads your full shortcut list live (alphabetical, with a Refresh button for when you add new ones) so you just pick one from a dropdown — no typing names or IDs, and nothing is pre-selected until you choose one. The button shows the shortcut's own icon, fetched straight from the Shortcuts app. Tapping the button runs it instantly via macOS's built-in `shortcuts` CLI, with a toast confirming success or showing the failure reason. Great for automations, HomeKit scenes, quick scripts, or anything else you've already built in Shortcuts.
